entry.description: Give up retrying a failed `AdoNetAppender` batch only while the database has not accepted an insert. Five rejected events in a row discarded the rest of the batch. A database that fails after start-up costs one round trip per event again (ANT-2026-WAJNPYNG, fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/355[#355])
